name: Gauge
text: A 24-hour canary to 5% still risks 1 in 20 users hitting a broken prompt—enough to tank trust if the prompt controls a critical path. A safer alternative is to auto-apply *only* routing tweaks (e.g., engine selection) via the Skill Pack’s safe-change rules, then manually validate prompt changes in staging with synthetic tests before a 1% canary. Settle it by running a 48-hour synthetic load test on the new prompt in isolation—if error rates stay flat, promote it; if not, scrap it.
